verdict.rationale: Google Cloud's Infrastructure Manager lets users define automation declaratively as Terraform, which is implicitly versionable as code, and create preview deployments to review changes before applying them. That covers the 'review' part of the story. API versioning (AIP-185) concerns Google's own API interfaces, not user automations, so it is not credited. A preview is a pre-apply review, not a rollback. missing for 10: documented versioning/revision history of user automations, documented rollback to a prior deployment or revision, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: Create preview deployments to see how changes affect your infrastructure before applying them.
